why_not: the same readers and the same words as the owner journey J-F-panel-737-06; this sign-in adds only its own name as the maker of a new plan
note: none
Limits: name 80 letters, 14 days, 30 exercises a day, 2000 members by name, 100 membership plans, about 20,000 bytes in all
A plan sent to a membership plan reaches a member only while that membership covers today
Cancel or close drops the whole draft with no question; Save locks while saving; a change at another desk is refused
Page words are plain English strings; weights are typed in kg (0.5 to 500): check a gym or member that uses lb
A wide builder sheet with many rows, move up and down buttons
Plans saved before per-set weights, notes and videos existed; a ready plan whose exercise is no longer in the list loses that exercise
The member app must get the routine and later changes; a withdrawn plan stays on the phone but stops changing

title: A workout offer with a 1-day reward says "Give 1 days" and "1 days added"
what: The owner may set the reward of a workout offer to 1 day (the form allows 1 to 7). The give button then reads "Give 1 days", the note after giving reads "1 days added for <name>", and the take-back question reads "Take back the 1 reward days". The offer name members see and the "Rewarded" line use the right word ("1 extra day", "1 day").
expected: With a reward of 1 day the button, the note and the question say "1 day".
how_often: every time an offer has a 1-day reward
fix_line: Use the same one-day wording the offer name already uses
